name: Omae no Natsuyasumi
source:
For summer vacation family plans to go to Hawaii. But selfish parents depart alone leaving main character to stay home with his two cousins. Protagonist takes out his anger on his cousins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
暑假里，一家人原本计划前往夏威夷。然而，任性的父母却自行出发，只留下主人公在家与两名表亲同住。主人公把心中的怒气发泄到了表亲身上。

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
